name: Tsugi no Medium
source:
This story revolves around Ikuro - an ordinary citizen of NIGHTFALL-04, lonely and miserable. He still doesn't have a family or a circle of close friends, but he's chock full of bad habits. It seems like nothing can change this status quo, but...

Due to unforeseen circumstances, Ikuro has to move into a new apartment, where he's met by the cheerful voice of HUMI - a modern generation home interface. From this day on, Ikuro's life starts going in a completely unexpected direction. 

"Everybody wants to find their place under the sun. However, this city hasn't seen any sun for years."

[From [url=https://nikita-kryukov.itch.io/tsugi-no-medium]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事围绕Ikuro展开。他是NIGHTFALL-04的一名普通市民，孤独又落魄。他至今没有自己的家庭，也没有亲密的朋友圈，却满身都是坏习惯。这样的生活似乎永远不会改变，然而……

一场意外迫使Ikuro搬进新公寓，迎接他的是新一代家居交互系统HUMI欢快的声音。从这一天起，他的人生开始朝完全意想不到的方向发展。

“人人都想找到属于自己的阳光。然而，这座城市已经很多年不见阳光了。”

[摘自[url=https://nikita-kryukov.itch.io/tsugi-no-medium]Itch.io[/url]]
